title: ProviderDynamicCapabilities
$comment: streamingAvailable and cancellationAvailable are tri-state on purpose: true, false, or absent. Absent means 'inherit the static declaration' and is a distinct state from both booleans. They must never become nullable: null would be a fourth state no consumer handles, and bridges omit the key specifically to preserve 'absent'.
description: A provider's live capability check, evaluated on the current host when routing or when checkCapabilities() is called. Unlike the descriptor it can change between calls.

available.description: Whether the provider is available and functional on this host right now.

reason.description: Why the provider is unavailable, when available is false.

streamingAvailable.description: Whether the provider can stream (Mode 2) on this host right now. Absent inherits the static descriptor.supports.streaming value; only set it when the host takes streaming away from a provider that otherwise declares it. Never null.

streamingUnavailableReason.description: Why streaming is unavailable, when streamingAvailable is false. Absent lets the route planner synthesize a default message.

cancellationAvailable.description: Whether cancellation is honored on this host right now. Absent inherits the static descriptor.cancel value: any value other than 'none' means available. Never null.

taskCapabilities.description: Per-task overrides of the provider-level check, for tasks whose availability differs on this host, e.g. a voice that is not installed. Every field of an entry is optional and absent inherits the provider-level value; a false at either level wins.

taskAvailability.title: ProviderTaskAvailability
taskAvailability.description: The live check for one task kind.

kind.description: The task kind this entry describes.

available.description: Whether the task can run on this host right now. Absent inherits the provider-level available. Never null.

reason.description: Why the task is unavailable, when available is false.

streamingAvailable.description: Whether the task can stream on this host right now. Absent inherits. Never null.

streamingUnavailableReason.description: Why streaming is unavailable for this task, when streamingAvailable is false.

cancellationAvailable.description: Whether cancellation is honored for this task right now. Absent inherits. Never null.

locales.description: BCP 47 locales available for this task right now. Absent means the provider cannot enumerate them.

voices.description: Voices available for this task right now. Absent means the provider cannot enumerate them; a request that requires a voice then never routes to it.

voice.title: ProviderVoice
voice.description: Provider-neutral traits of one available voice. Carries no provider voice identifier.

networkRequired.description: Whether using the voice sends data off the device. Absent inherits the task's privacy posture.

voiceGender.title: VoiceGender
voiceGender.description: Perceived gender of a voice, as the platform reports it.
